dataset_title: South Holland provincial green-area management inventory: English field dictionary
source_title: Areaal beheer - Groen - groenobjecten langs de provinciale wegen en vaarwegen in beheer van de provincie Zuid-Holland
geography: South Holland, Netherlands; provincial roads and waterways under provincial management
license: Public domain, as stated by the national open-data catalog
data_contents: The published WFS inventory schema includes route, route section, managed-object description, green type, slope, mowing method, ecological management, maintenance frequency, zone, polygon area and slope-corrected area, owner, manager, notes, district and maintenance crew.
scope_note: This local file translates the official feature-schema labels and descriptions into English. Attribute-only feature records were subsequently retrieved and grouped in roadside_grass_pzh_inventory_2026_summary_reference.csv; polygon geometries were not retrieved or spatially screened.
access_note: The public WFS was queried read-only for attributes only. The 37,188 feature attributes are summarized by source type, maintenance-frequency label and mowing-description label; the summary sidecar documents the query and transformations.
limitations: A gross green-area inventory includes non-grass objects and areas that may not be mowable, ecologically harvestable, accessible, or contractually available.
Mapped polygon area and slope-corrected area are not harvested biomass, delivered tonnage, dry-matter yield, or plant feed capacity.
Mowing and maintenance frequency values need source-code/value interpretation and do not establish measured cut dates or collected quantities.
No feedstock composition, contamination, moisture, collection efficiency, haul distance, cost, access rights, or annual mass is supplied by this field dictionary.
The field dictionary and aggregate summary do not activate any GreenHub default, parameter-registry value, or scenario input.
